name: MegaWix Performance Monitor for Core Web Vitals
author: MegaWix Technologies

sections.description:
MegaWix Performance Monitor for Core Web Vitals is a premium-grade performance monitoring and optimization utility built to bring official Google PageSpeed Insights telemetry directly into your WordPress admin — safely and automatically.

It includes a real-time Lighthouse 10 scanner, custom optimization engine, image performance fixes, and detailed health metrics. Ideal for site owners, SEO specialists, and developers who want a faster website with passing Core Web Vitals.

Version 1.0.0 includes a modern Glassmorphism UI, advanced activation/deactivation telemetry, and a powerful Performance Engine for font and script optimization.

Highlights

  • Lighthouse 10 Integration
    Fetch real-time lab and field data for both Mobile and Desktop versions of your site.

  • Core Web Vitals Tracking
    Deep monitoring of LCP (Loading), CLS (Stability), and INP (Interactivity) with color-coded status badges.

  • Automatic Performance Engine
    One-click activation for DNS prefetching, font-display: swap, and smart asset caching to reduce render-blocking.

  • Image Optimization Fixes
    Automatically serves WebP formats, injects missing dimensions, and preloads hero images to improve LCP scores.

  • Detailed Health Metrics
    Go beyond the basics with FCP, Speed Index, Total Blocking Time (TBT), and Time to First Byte (TTFB).

  • Field Data (CrUX) Assessment
    See if your actual users are having a “Pass” or “Fail” experience based on the last 28 days of real-world data.

  • Modern Glassmorphism UI
    A stunning, responsive dashboard designed for clarity and visual excellence.

  • Activation Welcome Popup
    Optionally subscribe to performance tips and share anonymous diagnostics to help us improve the tool.

  • Deactivation Feedback
    If you choose to leave, we collect optional feedback to understand how we can improve.

External Services

This plugin relies on external services to provide its core functionality. By using this plugin, you agree to the relevant terms and privacy policies outlined below.

  1. Google PageSpeed Insights API

    • Purpose: Fetches real-time Lighthouse 10 performance metrics (score, LCP, CLS, INP, FCP, TTFB, etc.) for your website.
    • When data is sent: Only when you click the “Refresh Analysis” button in the dashboard.
    • Data Sent: Your website’s public URL and your API Key (if provided).
    • Links: Google Privacy Policy | Google PageSpeed Terms of Service

  2. Google Fonts (fonts.googleapis.com)

    • Purpose: Provides typography for the plugin’s admin dashboard interface.
    • When data is sent: When an admin user loads the plugin dashboard page.
    • Data Sent: Standard HTTP request headers (IP address, User-Agent) required by Google’s servers to serve font files.
    • Links: Google Fonts Privacy FAQ | Google Privacy Policy

  3. Third-Party Script Delaying (Optional — User’s Own Scripts)

    • Purpose: The “Delay Third-Party Scripts” optimization feature rewrites script tags on your site’s frontend to load later (after user interaction). This affects scripts from these domains if present on your site: googletagmanager.com, google-analytics.com, facebook.net, tawk.to, hotjar.com.
    • When this applies: Only when the “Delay Third-Party Scripts” toggle is enabled in the Optimization Fixes tab.
    • Data Sent: This plugin itself does not send any data to these services. These are scripts your site may already use. The plugin simply delays when your browser loads them.
    • Links: Google Tag Manager Terms | Facebook Terms | Tawk.to Privacy | Hotjar Privacy

  4. MegaWix Technologies — Optional Site Diagnostics (Consent Required)

    • Purpose: Collects site diagnostics to help improve the plugin’s optimization logic and provide better support.
    • This is strictly opt-in: A welcome popup appears after activation with two options:
      • “Allow” — You give explicit consent and the following data is sent to https://www.plugin.megawix.com/.
      • “Skip” — No data is sent at all, now or in the future.
    • When data is sent:
      • On activation — once immediately after clicking “Allow” in the welcome popup.
      • On deactivation — once when the plugin is deactivated, but only if you previously chose “Allow”. A deactivation feedback popup will appear asking for an optional reason; this reason is also included in the data sent.
      • If you chose “Skip” — no data is sent on deactivation either.
    • Data collected with consent (Allow):
      • Site URL (site_url)
      • Site name (site_name)
      • Admin email (admin_email)
      • Plugin version (version)
      • WordPress version (wp_version)
      • PHP version (php_version)
      • Anonymized site hash — a one-way MD5 hash of the home URL (site_hash)
      • On deactivation only: selected reason (reason) and optional details (details)
    • Data collected without consent (Skip): None.
    • Links: MegaWix Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy

MegaWix Performance Monitor for Core Web Vitals is committed to full transparency:
* Anonymous Diagnostics (Strictly Opt-In) — If you explicitly click “Allow” in the welcome popup, anonymous, non-personal data (WP version, PHP version, plugin version, performance score, and a one-way hash of your site URL) is transmitted to MegaWix servers to improve optimization strategies. No email addresses, usernames, site names, or any personally identifiable information (PII) is ever collected or stored.
* External API (Required for Core Feature) — When you click “Refresh Analysis”, your site’s public URL is sent to Google’s PageSpeed Insights API. This is a necessary function of the plugin.
* No Passive Tracking — The plugin does not track site visitors, does not install cookies, and does not collect any data without your action.
* Local Storage — Your API key is stored securely in your own WordPress database and is never transmitted to MegaWix servers.

Credits

Developed with ❤️ by MegaWix Technologies

  • Plugin Development: MegaWix Technologies
  • Testing & QA: MegaWix Technologies

Support

Need help? Have a question or feature request?

  • Website: https://www.megawix.com
  • Email: info@megawix.com

We are committed to providing reliable support and regular updates to ensure your site stays fast and optimized.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to WordPress Admin → Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for MegaWix Performance Monitor for Core Web Vitals
  3. Click Install Now → Activate
  4. Navigate to Performance Lens in your WordPress sidebar

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Select the ZIP and install
  4. Click Activate Plugin

Initial Setup

  1. Open Performance Lens from your WordPress sidebar
  2. Enter your Google PageSpeed API Key (Get it free from Google Cloud)
  3. Click Refresh Analysis to start your first scan
  4. Enable the Performance Engine in the Optimization Fixes tab
sections.faq:
Do I need a Google API Key?

Yes. To fetch real-time PageSpeed data safely and quickly, a free API key from Google is required.

Does this plugin affect site speed?

Yes, it makes it faster! The Optimization Engine uses best practices to reduce render-blocking resources. The Dashboard itself runs in the admin and does not slow down your visitors.

What are Core Web Vitals?

They are a set of metrics (LCP, CLS, INP) that Google use to measure the health of a website’s user experience. Passing these is critical for SEO.

Is the data real-time?

Yes. When you click Refresh, the plugin fetches live data using the Lighthouse 10 engine.

Does it support mobile analysis?

Yes, you can toggle between Mobile and Desktop scores in the dashboard overview.

  • Official Google PageSpeed Insights API (Lighthouse 10) integration.
  • Advanced Activation & Deactivation telemetry for diagnostic site sync.
  • Modern Glassmorphism UI for all modals and dashboard components.
  • Real-time mobile & desktop analysis with color-coded health badges.
  • Automatic Performance Engine for DNS prefetching and font optimization.
  • Image optimization toolkit (WebP conversion and dimension injection).
  • Initial release of MegaWix Performance Monitor for Core Web Vitals.
  • Highly recommended for monitoring and optimizing your site performance.
